object_description: Elongated rectangular volume with rounded vertical access elements
design_condition: The elongated volume is placed low on the base of an excavation within dense greenery, docking with the terrain on two sides but generating substantial excavations and consuming protected garden and access space.

positive.statement: The volume is elongated and elegantly proportioned, giving the proposal a consistent and clear attitude.
The clear and systematic division of the space-forming structure works consistently across all floors.
The facade design with interlocking horizontal and vertical elements is recognized as a valuable contribution to the sophisticated design of a temporary building.
The supporting structure is consistent and simple, with well-distributed and almost symmetrical stabilizing walls.
The energy concept is plausibly and optimally solved, and the building should generate little maintenance effort.
The L-shaped foundation and retaining-wall arrangement is a valuable contribution to easy dismantling and component reuse.

negative.statement: The low placement produces considerable excavations whose overall appearance is unsatisfactory and does not fit the existing topography well.
The external vertical access is too technical, impairs access to the protected neighboring building, obscures the address, and consumes too much outdoor space.
The access arrangement creates a small-scale outdoor situation and offers little space for adequate open-space use.
The external access requires users to leave the climate envelope between floors, placing high demands on flexibility.
Not all floors function autonomously, and the multifunctional rooms have proportions that are not ideal for their users.
The susceptibility of the suspended ceilings to vibration would have to be demonstrated.
The hot-water storage arrangement is unfavorable for hygienic reasons and should be replaced by an energy storage solution.
The building occupies a relatively large amount of plot space, while its facade development leads to average gray-energy values.
Natural lighting in some of the main usable areas is insufficient.
